segments.name: Test and burn-in
segments.description: Designs and sells full wafer contact and burn-in test systems, test fixtures and related accessories to semiconductor manufacturers and test and assembly companies.
segments.evidence: The Company operates in one business segment, the designing, manufacturing, marketing and selling of advanced test and burn-in products to the semiconductor manufacturing industry in several geographic areas.

revenueModel.text: Semiconductor device manufacturers and contract test and assembly companies pay for test and burn-in systems, test fixtures and related accessories.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company manufactures and markets full wafer contact test systems, test during burn-in systems, test fixtures and related accessories.
